caption: The drawing depicts a single cylindrical mug positioned upright on a plain, unadorned background. The mug appears to be made of a light greyish or muted metallic material with subtle shading to indicate light and shadow. It features a rounded handle attached to the side, curving outward and then inward toward the mug. The cylindrical body of the mug has two faint horizontal bands circling its circumference, one near the base and one Tnear the middle, which add to the detailing of the object. The rim of the mug is slightly darker at the edge, and the inside of the mug is visible, with shading to suggest depth. The background is a plain, off-white or light beige color with no other objects present. There are some small, faint stains on the paper, and the artist's signature is visible in the lower left corner.
